mapper.select:
select
pro.P_Name as conProjectName, c.C_Name as conPartyBName, sdep.D_Name as conDepName, mn.* from Con_Contract mn left join Pre_Project pro on mn.con_Project_Id=pro.P_Id
left join SYS_Department sdep on sdep.D_Id=mn.Con_Department left join SYS_Company c on mn.con_Party_B_Id=c.C_Id
and mn.con_id in (select cpu.con_id from Contract_Permission_User cpu where cpu.u_id=#{params.uId})
and INSTR(mn.con_name,#{params.conName})
and INSTR(pro.P_Name,#{params.pName})
order by mn.${params.sortFiled} ${params.sortType}
order by ${params.sortSideFiled} ${params.sortType}
order by mn.Con_Create_Time desc
